site.name: Zagros
site.meta_description: Authorized Middle East distributor of K+S fertilizers and Barenbrug forage seeds. Water-soluble NPK, calcium, magnesium, potassium, and organic-certified inputs for vegetables, fruit trees, field crops, and forages.

about.title: About
about.headline: An operator, not a brand house.
about.deck: Zagros is an authorized Middle East distributor of K+S Group fertilizers and Barenbrug forage seeds. We do not manufacture — we operate. The job is to put the right input into the right field at the right rate, and to back that with technical service.
about.pillar_1_body: Agronomy desk on every order over a soil report's worth of complexity. Composition-first, not catalog-first.
about.pillar_2_body: Salt-stress, high-pH, low-rainfall, hot summers — the catalog is curated for what the region's fields actually face.
about.pillar_3_body: K+S German chemistry. Barenbrug global breeding. EU Organic certifications where the brief calls for them.

editors_note.headline: What separates an input distributor from a soil partner
editors_note.para1_body: he difference shows up at the second cut, not the bag. Anyone can move a pallet — fewer can tell you which K source won't lock out the calcium you'll need at fruit set, or why the Mediterranean lucerne block needs a different rate sheet than the irrigated one next door.
editors_note.para2: Issue 03 is built around three trials our agronomy desk audited in the last quarter — salt-stress tomato, citrus magnesium, and a side-by-side lucerne yield read. Each one is here because a customer asked us the question first.
editors_note.pull_quote: Specs forward. Data first. The bag arrives last.
editors_note.para3: If the catalog reads more like a service manual than a brochure, that's on purpose. Yield is the metric. Everything else is footnotes.
